selection_rule: Rank source rows by SHA256(seed|split|exact original-context SHA256); reserve pilots first; greedily skip any exact context, entity+sentence, or sentence already selected. No target labels or model outcomes affect ranking or selection.
compact_rule: Take the ranked prefix of each standard split using the compact scope counts.

hash_definitions.jsonl_line_sha256: Physical source line bytes excluding the line terminator.
hash_definitions.original_context_sha256: UTF-8 of the original context string.
hash_definitions.curator_evidence_sha256: UTF-8 of the extracted numbered question block.
hash_definitions.sentence_sha256: UTF-8 of NFKC-normalized sentences with whitespace collapsed.
